newsitem.title: CANADA: Ontario lowers rate on variable bonds to 3.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Ontario lowers rate on variable bonds to 3.25 pct.

text.p: The government of Ontario said on Tuesday that its 1996 variable-rate Ontario Savings Bonds will carry a 3.25 percent interest rate.
The variable rate bonds were initially set at 4.75 percent when they were issued in June 1996, the Ontario finance ministry said in a statement.
"The rate is re-set every six months and is competitive with what the market is offering for similar investment opportunities," the ministry said.
